query: select s.name as series_name,c.title as chapter_title,c.display_order as chapter_order,l.id as lesson_id,l.title as lesson_title,l.description,l.display_order as lesson_order,coalesce(length(btrim(l.content)),0) as content_length,l.is_active from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id join public.series s on s.id=o.series_id where sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and lv.name='Terminale' and s.name in ('A1','A2') order by s.name,c.display_order,l.display_order limit 100;
